official_sources.title: PROJ resource files and transformation-grid search path
official_sources.finding: PROJ transformation grids are searched through explicit paths, configured search paths, user-writable directories, PROJ_DATA, installation directories and optionally the network CDN. Grid availability is therefore part of reproducible coordinate-operation provenance.
official_sources.limitation: Grid search-path semantics do not prove that the exact OSGM15/OSTN15 grid used by the target run is the intended authoritative version.

official_sources.title: PROJ coordinate-operation selection controls
official_sources.finding: PROJ supports minimum desired accuracy, ALLOW_BALLPARK=NO and ONLY_BEST=YES; ONLY_BEST can force an error when the best known transformation cannot be used because required grids are unavailable.
official_sources.limitation: Operation-selection controls improve fail-closed behavior but still require exact source/target CRS, area and runtime grid inventory.

official_sources.title: PROJ vertical grid shift
official_sources.finding: PROJ vertical grid shift applies vertical offsets from transformation grids; grid-list order defines precedence and @ marks a grid optional, meaning absence may otherwise be tolerated.
official_sources.limitation: Optional-grid syntax is unacceptable for terminal ODN conversion unless absence is an explicit non-final QA scenario.

official_sources.title: PROJ horizontal grid shift
official_sources.finding: PROJ horizontal grid shifts use prioritized grid lists and optional @ grids; temporal grid shifts may also depend on observation and transformation epochs.
official_sources.limitation: The target height workflow must not accidentally inherit optional or time-dependent horizontal behavior without explicit policy.

official_sources.title: PROJ general grid shift
official_sources.finding: PROJ general gridshift can apply horizontal and/or vertical offsets using GeoTIFF geodetic grids and supports explicit vertical offset grid types.
official_sources.limitation: Generic gridshift capability does not identify the correct UK national transformation automatically.

official_sources.title: PROJ network capabilities and remote grids
official_sources.finding: PROJ networking can transparently fetch required grid chunks from the PROJ CDN when enabled, so local-only and network-enabled runs can have different available coordinate operations.
official_sources.limitation: Remote availability must be recorded and network-fetched grid identity must be reproducible; network success alone is not provenance.

official_sources.title: PROJ geodetic TIFF grid specification
official_sources.finding: PROJ geodetic TIFF grids are structured GeoTIFF resources for horizontal, vertical and other geodetic offsets and are inspectable with GDAL.
official_sources.limitation: A valid GTG file still needs exact digest, metadata and operation binding.

official_sources.title: PROJ operation computation algorithm
official_sources.finding: PROJ computes candidate coordinate operations from CRS metadata and available resources; transformation selection is a metadata-driven step distinct from the numerical transform itself.
official_sources.limitation: Candidate enumeration must be captured because software/database/grid changes can alter the selected operation.

official_sources.title: projinfo grid-check, area and ballpark controls
official_sources.finding: projinfo can restrict area of interest, inspect candidate operation accuracy, hide ballpark operations and vary grid-availability policy with grid-check modes.
official_sources.limitation: A diagnostic listing is not the executed transform; the chosen operation must be serialized and compared with runtime execution.

official_sources.title: PROJ 3D promotion semantics in cs2cs
official_sources.finding: PROJ documents that starting with PROJ 9.1 both CRS need appropriate 3D treatment for vertical transformation to possibly occur, and --3d explicitly promotes 2D CRS to ellipsoidal-height 3D forms.
official_sources.limitation: Implicit 2D/3D promotion can change vertical behavior across versions and must be rejected for terminal replay.

official_sources.title: Ordnance Survey OSGM15 national geoid model
official_sources.finding: OSGM15 converts ETRS89 ellipsoidal heights to orthometric heights. In mainland Britain it yields ODN heights directly, uses a 1 km grid with bilinear interpolation and has nominal model accuracy of 8 mm RMS; other islands and offshore areas can use different local vertical datums or ODN Offshore.
official_sources.limitation: The 8 mm figure is model accuracy, not total parcel-elevation accuracy; location must be verified as mainland ODN coverage.

official_sources.title: Ordnance Survey OSTN15 national grid transformation
official_sources.finding: OSTN15 is the definitive OSGB36/ETRS89 transformation for Great Britain and uses a 1 km transformation grid with bilinear interpolation rather than a simple Helmert transformation.
official_sources.limitation: OSTN15 horizontal correctness does not by itself prove vertical ODN transformation correctness.

official_sources.title: Ordnance Survey coordinate transformation resources
official_sources.finding: Ordnance Survey publishes OSTN15/OSGM15 developer resources, raw grids, test samples and OSGM15 GTX files; OSTN15/OSGM15 replaced OSTN02/OSGM02 in August 2016.
official_sources.limitation: Resource availability does not authorize using reduced-density Lite grids for terminal high-accuracy transformation.

official_sources.title: Ordnance Survey CRS and transformation identifiers
official_sources.finding: Ordnance Survey lists EPSG identifiers including OSGB36/British National Grid 27700, compound BNG+ODN 7405, ODN 5701, OSGM15 transformation 7711 and OSTN15 transformation 7953.
official_sources.limitation: Identifier capture prevents horizontal-only EPSG:27700 from being mistaken for a compound height CRS.

official_sources.title: EPSG ODN height CRS 5701
official_sources.finding: EPSG:5701 is the valid ODN height vertical CRS for geodesy and engineering survey, sourced from Ordnance Survey.
official_sources.limitation: A vertical CRS identifier alone does not select the transformation operation or grid resource.

official_sources.title: EPSG BNG plus ODN compound CRS 7405
official_sources.finding: EPSG:7405 is the valid compound CRS combining OSGB36 / British National Grid horizontally with ODN height vertically.
official_sources.limitation: Using EPSG:7405 requires confirming the raster values actually represent ODN heights rather than simply assigning the CRS label.

official_sources.title: EPSG ETRS89 to ODN height transformation 7711
official_sources.finding: EPSG transformation 7711 is ETRS89-GBR [OSNet v2009] to ODN height using the OSGM15 geoid model and records 0.008 m accuracy.
official_sources.limitation: The stated 0.008 m transformation accuracy is not a measured accuracy of the target DTM elevation itself.

official_sources.title: GDAL vertical transformation in gdalwarp
official_sources.finding: GDAL can apply vertical transformations to single-band rasters when source or target CRS is explicitly vertical/3D; geoid grids may be required, unit conversions can be applied, and -et 0 disables the approximating transformer for true pixel-by-pixel reprojection comparisons.
official_sources.limitation: Raster warping is derived processing; terminal native-cell extrema should not be silently replaced by warped/resampled output.

candidates.name: Exact ODN vertical CRS identity chain
OSTN15 horizontal plus OSGM15 vertical separation chain
Network versus local grid inventory equivalence chain
Mainland ODN versus island/local datum guard chain
No Lite reduced-density grid terminal chain
Transform-model accuracy not DTM accuracy chain
Primary and independent vertical-operation replay digest chain
